decisions: Group the two TLS frame operations. Initialize the frame pointer at declaration after saving LastError. Preserve exact top-frame matching, in_C and LastError on native unwind. Original Unsimulate jumps to the retired context.

Per-frame completion separates a DPMI-emulated instruction from an ordinary fault at decoder resumption. Set on success, clear on first delivery, initialize on frame reuse. Header owns the completion reason.
